title: Friday flyer
details: Open to all. Approx. 7pm start, races to 5. Max 32 players, 8 tables in play.
£15 entry. Payment secures your spot: online or cash behind the bar before the night. First 32 paid are in.
Prizes based on 32 entries: £100 winner, £50 runner-up, £30 semi-finals, £10 quarter-finals. Plate (races to 3): £30 winner, £10 runner-up.
Ranking points count towards the grand final on Saturday 14 November. Bring cash for the break-run dish.

title: Free competition
details: Free to enter. 2pm start.
£70 winner, £30 runner-up. Plate winner gets a month's free membership.
Handicaps: C scratch (0), D +1, E and below +2. All matches start from handicap level.
Say "in" on the Facebook post to secure your spot. Bring cash for the break-run dish.

title: £20 double elimination
details: Run by Big Dave Pool Promotions. 10:00 start. Open category, max 48 players.
Double elimination, races to 7 and 5. Blackball rules.
£20 entry. Prize fund: £360 winner, £180 runner-up, £80 semi-finals, £40 quarter-finals.
Payment secures your place. Full details and registration on the Facebook post.

title: D & E straight knockout
details: For D and E players. Registration 11:00, first games 12:00. Max 16 players.
Races to 7 throughout. Handicaps: E players +1, D players 0.
£20 entry. Prizes: £180, £80, semi-finals £30.
Round of 16, quarter-finals, semi-finals, final.

title: Friday flyer
details: The last flyer before grand final day. Approx. 7pm start.
Full details will be posted in the Facebook group.

title: Flyer grand final day
details: The grand final for this season's Friday flyers.
Places are decided by ranking points, and you must have attended at least four flyers to qualify.
